newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK ECONMIN ABOLISHES A FINMIN SECRETARIAT-SOURCE.
newsitem.headline: GREEK ECONMIN ABOLISHES A FINMIN SECRETARIAT-SOURCE.

text.p: Greek National Economy and Finance Minister Yannos Papandoniou abolished the finance ministry's special secretariat headed by Dimitris Dritsas on Monday, a national economy source told Reuters.

Dritsas had been appointed special secretary responsible for budget and public debt matters after retiring in 1994. He headed the finance ministry's National Accounting Office for many years prior to his retirement. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
